note: each refusal's message starts with rule_messages[rule] in both languages; cases named order_* carry several violations and pin which rule is reported first

rule_messages.EXECUTION_FEED: execution-grade requirements need an execution-price validation feed
rule_messages.INTERVAL_NOT_ALLOWED: interval is valid only for bar or metric-series requirements
rule_messages.METRIC_INTERVAL: metric-series requirements need a sampling interval
rule_messages.OI_INTERVAL_BLANK: open-interest sampling interval cannot be blank
rule_messages.RECENCY_OBSERVE_SLA: observed event recency requires an explicit provider session SLA
rule_messages.WARMUP_DEADLINE: warmup deadline_ms must be between 100 and 120000
rule_messages.WARMUP_INTERVAL_SOURCE: warmup interval source policy is required
rule_messages.WARMUP_ROWS_PUBLIC: public V2 warmup rows cannot exceed 10000
rule_messages.WARMUP_ROWS_RANGE: warmup rows must be between 1 and 100000
rule_messages.WARMUP_TIME_RANGE: warmup time range must be positive and increasing
rule_messages.WARMUP_TIME_RANGE_LIMIT: time-range warmup cannot also declare warmup_limit
